notes.title: New Major update 1.2 for Pixel Madness!
notes.content:
- Added a laboratory where you can create pets to get more resources every click!

- Added Steam Leaderboards!
* Leaderboard for levels.
* Leaderboard for score.

- Fixed user interface!
* Shop buttons have been fixed.

- New achievements added!
* 6 New achievements for the Laboratory.


- Optimization of the code to reduce lags in the game!

- Balance improvements!
* Biome efficiencies now give far fewer resources than they did before.
* Price changes in the store.


- Added support for Steam inventory service!
* Now you can get an item that can be put on the showcase of steam items.

- Now your Steam username will be displayed in the boss fight!

- Medals for the first place in the top were added
 * Every week on Sunday we will give medals to those who reach #1 on the leaderboard.
   * Be sure to join the discord so that we can contact you if you win!

https://discord.gg/crtd5sJ2Fs

notes.title: New Major update 1.1 for Pixel Madness!
notes.content:
First release is soon so we introduce new Major update!

- Added new Heaven World !
 * New world system.

- Added new achievements!
 * 6 Heaven World achievements.

- UI changes!

- Balance fixes
